errata.evidence: The cover (p. 1) reads 'Bangkok, Thailand, 6-10 June 2006'; the programme (p. 20) opens 'Tuesday, 6 June 2006', and 6 June 2006 was a Tuesday; the copyright page (p. 2) is dated September 2006.

narrative.text: The introduction dates the workshop June 2005; the cover and the programme date it June 2006, which the weekday in the programme confirms.
